subject: How to color just the branches of a tree without using GroupOTU

messages.author: bf4662a8aa66b617
messages.subject: How to color just the branches of a tree without using GroupOTU
parts:
Hi I'm having some trouble just coloring the branches of a tree that I generated using RAxML.
I have attached 2 files, the bipartitionsBranchLabels to include bootstrapped probabilities as well as the csv containing the list of tips that I would like to highlight.

I understand somewhat of the general approach according to : https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/bioc-ggtree/zjTeAbMQbDg
But I am having trouble implementing whilst including the base RAxML so that I still have access to the bootstrapped values.

GroupOTU colors all the interior edges and every node along the way to the branch which isn't what I want. Just looking to color the individual tips.
A step-by-step breakdown would be the most helpful if someone is available to assist.

Thanks for reading.

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: How to color just the branches of a tree without using GroupOTU
parts:
The link in your post is a good solution to your problem.

If you have problems in getting node id of selected tips, you can use tidytree::nodeid to convert node labels to node ids.
